title: DialogueResponse
description: A response generated by an NPC during dialogue.

utterance.description: The text spoken by the NPC.

dialogue_act.description: The pragmatic function of this utterance.

referenced_claim_ids.description: Claim IDs that this utterance touches upon.

animation_tag.description: Optional animation or pose identifier for this response.

requests_world_action.description: Dialogue responses never directly trigger world actions; must always be false.

safety_flags.description: Safety or content-warning flags associated with this response.
